items.title: How long until the pattern actually gets a response?
items.description: L3's Path A and Path B started from identical signs but ended up months apart: Path A took 4 months (self-doubt dismissed each sign individually) to become a visible problem; Path B took about 1 month (the combination was named specifically to a manager) to get a real fix. Drag "How much self-doubt dismisses each sign" up toward Path A's territory, or "How specifically the combination gets named" up toward Path B's, and watch the delay move between those two real outcomes.

params.name: dismissalTendency
params.label: How much self-doubt dismisses each sign ("am I just being dramatic?")

params.name: namingSpecificity
params.label: How specifically the combination gets named

items.compute: const x = params.dismissalTendency / 100; const y = params.namingSpecificity / 100; const months = 1 + 6.9 * x * (1 - y); return { months: Math.round(months * 10) / 10 };

outputs.label: Months until the pattern gets a real response
